**A minimized window is no longer in the way.**

Your assistant used to get a refusal as soon as the shared window was minimized. KnightSight now brings the window back on its own, behind your other windows and without taking the focus, so you keep working where you are.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Minimized windows come back.** When your assistant asks for a minimized window, KnightSight restores it behind your other windows without taking the focus and gives it a moment to draw before the picture. This works on Windows, on macOS and on Linux with X11. Wayland offers no way to do it, so there a minimized window stays out of reach.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **On macOS, minimizing the shared window no longer ends the share.** The window server leaves a minimized window out when asked for it alone, and KnightSight took that for a closed window.
